prompt: You need to rename a column without downtime while old and new app versions run side by side during deploy.
tells: old and new app versions run side by side
why: Add the new column, write to both, backfill, switch reads, then drop the old one.
trap: A single rename breaks whichever version runs.

prompt: Adding a NOT NULL column with a default locked a 500 million row table for an hour.
why: Add it nullable, backfill in batches, then add the constraint.
trap: Do schema changes in safe steps.

prompt: Address fields must move from users into a new addresses table without breaking running code.
tells: move from users into a new addresses table
why: Expand (new table + dual writes), migrate, then contract (drop old fields).

prompt: After a migration dropped a column, rolling back the app failed because the old code needed it.
why: Drop in a later release, once nothing reads the column.
trap: Contract last, after the code no longer depends on it.
